title: Cover the remaining ordinary task-sync CLI recovery paths
outcome: Cover the remaining ordinary task-sync CLI recovery paths
acceptance: Behavioral CLI checks exercise a receiving fast-forward, an absent remote branch, and a real task-file merge conflict that stops publication and preserves the pending merge.
A held import reports the task and data folder with original-option retry guidance, and the ordinary Git runner's timeout cleanup is exercised without a real 60-second wait.
